diagnostics.message: splunk_configs_conf.forgecicd_cloudwatchlogs references transform stanza "forgecicd_trust_validation" in its variables map (REPORT-forgecicd_trust_validation) but does not depend on splunk_configs_conf.forgecicd_trust_validation. The REPORT string is not an attribute reference, so Terraform cannot infer the ordering; the transform should exist before the props config that reports on it. Add it to depends_on (a bare depends_on is required since the REPORT value must be the exact bare stanza name, not the resource's transforms/... .name).
